findings.function: multicall(bytes[]), tryExecute((address,uint256,bytes)[]), getWithdrawableAssets, getCreditInfo (return/argument encoding loops)
findings.decompiled: while True: / if s >= mem[128]: / require ext_code.size(0x1148...) / delegate 0x1148... with: args mem[mem[64] len u - mem[64]] / _45 = delegate.return_code / require not _45 / ... / return memory from mem[64] len 32 / mem[v] = u - mem[64] - 68 / ... / continue
findings.source: GovPool.sol:161-166 try actions.tryExecute() { revert(); } catch (bytes memory reason) { return abi.decode(reason, (bool)); }  |  Multicall.sol:18-24 return results;
findings.issue: The ABI-encoding loop of the call's argument (or of the returned bytes[]) is printed as 'while True' whose first statement 'if s >= n:' holds the whole rest of the function (the delegatecall, the decoding and the return), instead of 'while s < n: ...' followed by that code.
findings.rule: When the exit branch of a loop test ends the function (return/revert) and is not otherwise inside the loop, print the loop as 'while not exit_cond:' and move the exit branch after the loop.

findings.issue: Members of structs held in (nested) mappings print as raw slot arithmetic when the inferred type of stor223 ('mapping of mapping of mapping of struct of 4 slots', built from other accesses) does not fit, although the same function prints stor223[_param2][_param1][_param3].field_256 for a deeper member.
findings.rule: sha3(k, s) + j is member j of the struct at s[k] and sha3(k2, sha3(k1, s)) + j is member j of s[k1][k2]; print it as stor223[_param1].field_2048 (member 8, the set's length) and stor223[_param2][_param1].field_256, letting def storage hold a struct whose member 0 is itself a mapping.
Print a power of ten as 10**k (fold c * 10**m when c is itself a power of ten).

findings.issue: The external library functions are reached by DELEGATECALL to linked-library addresses that are placeholders in this unlinked runtime code (all 0x11...); their bodies, and the loops in them (GovPoolCreate, GovPoolView.getProposals, GovPoolRewards...), are not part of this bytecode. Faithful to this bytecode.

notes: All 61 ABI functions and the receive-only fallback reviewed in full (the text is 2,770 lines: most functions are an access check plus one or more delegatecalls to libraries, with the ABI encoding/decoding of their arguments and results). Checked against the source: the onlyThis/onlyBABTHolders/onlyValidatorContract/injector checks, the getters (struct field offsets of Proposal.core: voteEnd at bit 2304, quorum at 256, rawVotesFor/Against at 3072/3328), initializer, editDescriptionURL and __GovPool_init's string storage writes (copy lines with tail clearing), deposit/withdraw/delegate/undelegate/delegateTreasury/undelegateTreasury (BlockGuard lock writes keyed by the string resource, SafeERC20, NFT transfer loop, events with calldata arrays), tryExecute's try/catch (extcodesize check, 'require not success' for the revert in the try block, bool decode of the reason), multicall (delegatecall loop with Address.verifyCallResult). No semantic error found. Loops: only 4 source loops are in this bytecode (delegateTreasury's NFT transfer loop, claimRewards, claimMicropoolRewards, OZ Multicall), all whiles; the ~25 other source loops of the pack are in external library functions reached by delegatecall (artifact finding). Of the 55 text whiles, 21 are memory-to-memory copies (bytes copies of solc 0.8.20 without mcopy and ABI encodings, P7) and the rest are calldata-decoding and encoding loops of dynamic arrays; 'new bytes[](n)' init is rotated ('while idx - 1', P3). The P2 lines and 9 'from mem[64]' reverts come from the free-memory aliasing root cause (see c00578). setDependencies stores addresses as 'stor211 = ext_call.return_data[12 len 20]' (the slice pattern of c00578).
summary: Faithful and fairly compact: most functions are checks plus delegatecalls to placeholder library addresses whose loops are outside this bytecode; the remaining issues are encoding loops left as whiles (one shape puts the function's tail inside 'while True: if s >= n'), struct members of nested mappings printed as raw slot arithmetic, and 10**27 printed as 1000000000 * 10**18.
